## AccessGrant

- API version: `protem.dev/v1alpha1`
- Scope: Namespaced
- Resource names: `accessgrants`, `agrant`

AccessGrant represents an active, time-bound access lease for a user.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Enum | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec` | object | no |  |  | AccessGrant core spec is immutable after creation | AccessGrantSpec defines the immutable lease snapshot and revocation state. |
| `spec.clusters` | []string | no |  |  |  | Clusters targeted by this grant |
| `spec.expiresAt` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |  | ExpiresAt is the absolute time when access elevation expires |
| `spec.namespaces` | []string | no |  |  |  | Namespaces targeted by this grant |
| `spec.profileRef` | string | yes |  |  |  | ProfileRef is the name of the AccessProfile in the same namespace |
| `spec.requestRef` | string | yes |  |  |  | RequestRef is the name of the AccessRequest in the same namespace |
| `spec.requester` | object | yes |  |  |  | Requester is the snapshot of the user identity |

| `spec.requester.username` | string | yes |  |  |  |  |

| `spec.revocation.by` | string | no |  |  |  | By is the identity that revoked the elevation |

- Scope: Namespaced
- Resource names: `accessprofiles`, `aprofile`

## AccessRequest

- API version: `protem.dev/v1alpha1`
- Scope: Namespaced
- Resource names: `accessrequests`, `areq`

## ClusterGrant

- API version: `protem.dev/v1alpha1`
- Scope: Namespaced
- Resource names: `clustergrants`, `cgrant`, `clgrant`

ClusterGrant represents a single-cluster slice of an AccessGrant, living in protem-cluster-<name>.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Enum | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec` | object | no |  |  |  | ClusterGrantSpec defines the per-cluster elevation lease dispatched to a spoke cluster's namespace. |
| `spec.expiresAt` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |  | ExpiresAt is the absolute time when access elevation expires |
| `spec.grantRef` | string | yes |  |  |  | GrantRef references the parent AccessGrant in its origin namespace |
| `spec.namespaces` | []string | no |  |  |  | Namespaces targeted by this grant on this cluster |
| `spec.profileRef` | string | yes |  |  |  | ProfileRef is the AccessProfile name |
| `spec.requester` | object | yes |  |  |  | Requester is the snapshot of the user identity |
| `spec.requester.email` | string | yes |  |  |  |  |
| `spec.requester.groups` | []string | no |  |  |  |  |
| `spec.requester.username` | string | yes |  |  |  |  |
| `spec.revocation` | object | no |  |  |  | Revocation details if revoked early |
| `spec.revocation.at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |  | At is the timestamp when revocation took effect |
| `spec.revocation.by` | string | no |  |  |  | By is the identity that revoked the elevation |
| `spec.revocation.reason` | string | no |  |  |  | Reason explains why elevation was revoked |
| `spec.role` | object | yes |  |  |  | Role snapshot to bind |
| `spec.role.kind` | string | yes |  | `"Role"`, `"ClusterRole"` |  | Kind is either "Role" or "ClusterRole" |
| `spec.role.name` | string | yes |  |  |  | Name is the name of the Role or ClusterRole |
| `spec.scope` | string | yes |  | `"Namespaced"`, `"Cluster"` |  | Scope indicates Namespaced or Cluster |
| `spec.subject` | string | no |  |  |  | Subject is the resolved username/subject mapped for this cluster |
| `status` | object | no |  |  |  | ClusterGrantStatus defines the observed state reported by the spoke agent. |
| `status.bindings` | []object | no |  |  |  | Bindings created on the spoke cluster |
| `status.bindings[].kind` | string | yes |  |  |  |  |
| `status.bindings[].name` | string | yes |  |  |  |  |
| `status.bindings[].namespace` | string | no |  |  |  |  |
| `status.lastTransitionTime` | string (date-time) | no |  |  |  | LastTransitionTime timestamp of last status change |
| `status.message` | string | no |  |  |  | Message describes error or enforcement status from spoke |
| `status.phase` | string | no |  | `"Pending"`, `"Active"`, `"Expired"`, `"Revoked"`, `"Failed"` |  | Phase is Pending, Active, Expired, Revoked, or Failed |
| `status.rules` | []object | no |  |  |  | Rules are the rules of the ClusterRole the agent bound, as read on that cluster. Empty for a namespaced Role, whose rules can differ per namespace. |
| `status.rules[].apiGroups` | []string | no |  |  |  | APIGroups is the name of the APIGroup that contains the resources. If multiple API groups are specified, any action requested against one of the enumerated resources in any API group will be allowed. "" represents the core API group and "*" represents all API groups. |
| `status.rules[].nonResourceURLs` | []string | no |  |  |  | NonResourceURLs is a set of partial urls that a user should have access to. *s are allowed, but only as the full, final step in the path Since non-resource URLs are not namespaced, this field is only applicable for ClusterRoles referenced from a ClusterRoleBinding. Rules can either apply to API resources (such as "pods" or "secrets") or non-resource URL paths (such as "/api"), but not both. |
| `status.rules[].resourceNames` | []string | no |  |  |  | ResourceNames is an optional white list of names that the rule applies to. An empty set means that everything is allowed. |
| `status.rules[].resources` | []string | no |  |  |  | Resources is a list of resources this rule applies to. '*' represents all resources. |
| `status.rules[].verbs` | []string | yes |  |  |  | Verbs is a list of Verbs that apply to ALL the ResourceKinds contained in this rule. '*' represents all verbs. |

## TargetCluster

- API version: `protem.dev/v1alpha1`
- Scope: Cluster
- Resource names: `targetclusters`, `tcluster`

TargetCluster represents a managed spoke Kubernetes cluster registered with the Protem fleet Hub.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Enum | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec` | object | no |  |  |  | TargetClusterSpec defines the desired configuration and connection settings for a cluster. |
| `spec.description` | string | no |  |  |  |  |
| `spec.displayName` | string | yes |  |  |  |  |
| `spec.enforcement` | string | no | `"RoleBinding"` | `"RoleBinding"`, `"Authorizer"` |  | Enforcement selects the enforcement mechanism on this cluster (default: RoleBinding) |
| `spec.paused` | boolean | no | `false` |  |  | Paused suspends new elevation leases on this cluster for maintenance |
| `spec.subject` | string | no | `"{{.Email}}"` |  |  | Subject defines the username mapping template on this cluster (e.g. {{.Email}} or oidc:{{.Email}}) |
| `status` | object | no |  |  |  | TargetClusterStatus defines the observed health and connectivity of the cluster. |
| `status.activeGrantsCount` | integer | no |  |  |  | ActiveGrantsCount tracks currently active leases on this cluster |
| `status.agentVersion` | string | no |  |  |  | AgentVersion reports the running spoke agent version |
| `status.conditions` | []object | no |  |  |  | Conditions represent observations of cluster readiness and agent connectivity |
| `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |  | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `status.conditions[].message` | string | yes |  |  | max length 32768 | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `status.conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer (int64) | no |  |  | minimum 0 | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `status.conditions[].reason` | string | yes |  |  | pattern `^[A-Za-z]([A-Za-z0-9_,:]*[A-Za-z0-9_])?$`; min length 1; max length 1024 | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `status.conditions[].status` | string | yes |  | `"True"`, `"False"`, `"Unknown"` |  | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. |
| `status.conditions[].type` | string | yes |  |  | pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?(([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9])$`; max length 316 | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `status.lastHeartbeat` | string (date-time) | no |  |  |  | LastHeartbeat timestamp of last contact from spoke agent |
| `status.phase` | string | no |  | `"Ready"`, `"Disconnected"`, `"Maintenance"` |  | Phase is Ready, Disconnected, or Maintenance |
